'''Pendarr III''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pendarran Warriors]], a military organization headed by [[Gendal Delan]] which worked alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] ordered the Pendarran Warriors killed in the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The survivors formed [[Pendarran's Revenge]].
